Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.template

Record Class OrderTemplateRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.template.OrderTemplateRequest
Record Components:
name - what the client calls it, up to 40 characters
side - BUY or SELL
orderType - the order type to set up
timeInForce - DAY (when null) or GTC, for orders other than MARKET
limitOffsetPercent - for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT: the limit price as percent from the market
stopOffsetPercent - for STOP and STOP_LIMIT: the stop price as percent from the market
trailPercent - for TRAILING_STOP: how many percent the stop trails
takeProfitPercent - for a BUY bracket: percent above the entry price to take profit at
stopLossPercent - for a BUY bracket: percent below the entry price to cut losses at
public record OrderTemplateRequest(@NotBlank(message="name is required") @Size(max=40,message="name may have at most 40 characters") String name, Order.Side side, Order.OrderType orderType, Order.TimeInForce timeInForce, @DecimalMin(value="-99.00",message="limitOffsetPercent must be between -99 and 1000") @DecimalMax(value="1000.00",message="limitOffsetPercent must be between -99 and 1000") @Digits(integer=4,fraction=2,message="limitOffsetPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal limitOffsetPercent, @DecimalMin(value="-99.00",message="stopOffsetPercent must be between -99 and 1000") @DecimalMax(value="1000.00",message="stopOffsetPercent must be between -99 and 1000") @Digits(integer=4,fraction=2,message="stopOffsetPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal stopOffsetPercent, @DecimalMin(value="0.10",message="trailPercent must be between 0.1 and 50") @DecimalMax(value="50.00",message="trailPercent must be between 0.1 and 50") @Digits(integer=2,fraction=2,message="trailPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal trailPercent, @DecimalMin(value="0.01",message="takeProfitPercent must be between 0.01 and 1000") @DecimalMax(value="1000.00",message="takeProfitPercent must be between 0.01 and 1000") @Digits(integer=4,fraction=2,message="takeProfitPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal takeProfitPercent, @DecimalMin(value="0.01",message="stopLossPercent must be between 0.01 and 99") @DecimalMax(value="99.00",message="stopLossPercent must be between 0.01 and 99") @Digits(integer=2,fraction=2,message="stopLossPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal stopLossPercent) extends Record
A ticket setup to save. Offsets are signed percent from the price the side fills at (the ask for a buy, the bid for a sell); a bracket's two percents are measured from the entry price.
